content.short: Capture the Ether is a game where players hack Ethereum smart contracts to learn about security.
content.description: Capture the Ether is an educational game that teaches players to hack Ethereum contracts. The game presents a series of challenges across categories, and players earn points for each completed challenge. A warmup category introduces the basic tools to get started, helping newcomers build familiarity with the material. Total beginners can also begin with Program the Blockchain to read background material before tackling more advanced challenges at their own pace.
content.meta: Capture the Ether is an educational game about hacking Ethereum contracts. Discover Capture the Ether and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Every Challenge, Worked Through
resources.tldr: Full solutions to the wargame, with the reasoning left in. Most of the lessons still apply years after it launched.

resources.title: Breaking the Lottery Contracts
resources.tldr: Why on-chain randomness derived from block data is not random, demonstrated against contracts built to look convincing.

resources.title: Arithmetic as an Attack Surface
resources.tldr: Overflow, underflow and forced ether transfers via selfdestruct, each shown as a working exploit rather than a warning.
